#  12892 - Labor Network Control Technology and Dynamics Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **12892 - module is no longer offered from WS 2021/22**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Labor Network Control Technology and Dynamics**  |  
|  Labor Netzleittechnik und -dynamik   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 3 - Mechanical Engineering, Electrical and Energy Systems   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.-Ing. Schiffer, Johannes 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every summer semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  |  Practical Knowledge and Experiences about
  * the Behaviour of Power Networks
  * important Operations in Network Control Stations

 |  
| Contents:  |  practical work on a network control system, developement of an own project to realise main tasks of the control system:operations, safety, stability, optimisation . . .  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Network Control Technology and Dynamics 2 (Modul 12891)  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Practical training / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  |  instructions for the practical work and some theoretical aspects are given as printouts literature see modul 12891 "Network Control Technology and Dynamics 1"   |  
| Module Examination:  | Prerequisite + Final Module Examination (MAP)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  |  Prerequisite:
  * take part on all laboratory dates to realise an own and complete network control project (the necessary number of laboratory exercises will be announced at the the beginning of the course)

Final Module Examination:
  * 20 minutes oral examination/presentation with 20 minutes preparation time (Content: behaviour of energy networks, parts of control systems, the own project)

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | First lecture in summer semester 2022.  |  
| Module Components:  |  practical training self organised studies/preparation  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 21.06.2021 
  * without Follow-up Module/s

 |
